purpose: Full native defensive disarm target admission and consequence request ordering, plus side-power shared target lookup. No actual inventory/runtime acceptance.

defensive.exclude: Source and target cannot both be the Player singleton.

side_power.scope: Suffix after original source/direction admission; before actual drop consequences.

actual_instructions: 5FC2B0 defensive caller branches and request order
expected: Actual5FC2B0 calls actual5E4A80, WEAP quest predicate4D7030, high-process drawn predicate64AD30 and rank56A300. Creature source exits before target query. Player/NPC/Creature target vtables are covered; only one actor may be the Player singleton.

Target5E4A80 requires an equipped WEAP, drawn process and nonquest predicate. Player65D820 reads rawB3BB06; nonzero suppresses target lookup before process access. This experiment does not assign a gameplay meaning to that byte.

For an eligible target, Master shield Block or unarmed HandToHand takes the inclusive<=5 roll. Source drawn is checked after RNG. Side-power suffix uses Journeyman and the same target query, with the same guard order.
Successful defensive proc requests virtual+2C8(weapon,firstExtraData,1,null,null). NPC/Creature dispatch to5FC440; Player dispatches to660CC0. Actual drop bodies are recording boundaries.

The caller unconditionally requests4DC000(target,returnedReference), including a null drop result. It still continues controller/action requests and returns true. That boolean does not prove actual inventory removal.
